messages:
samira: Heads-up: new model 'sable-v1' (q5) on staging showing mixed CJK+RTL token bleed in small translate smoke. Minimal repro below.

yuki: paste the example + tokenizer/qconfig please.

samira: Repro: Input: Translate to Arabic: 今天我们要试
Model: sable-v1-q5, tokenizer: sable-tokenizer-2026-03-05
Actual: "اليوم الجروح 今 天 我 们" (CJK appear as spaced subtokens inside Arabic stream)

dan: sounds like merges.json pruning or normalization mismatch during quant. Any diffs vs prod tokenizer?

kevin: quick diff: sable-tokenizer-2026-03-05 toggles nfkd_normalize=true and has merge_prune_threshold=2 for quant. Also ZWNJ mapping changed.

triage-bot: nightly/sable_q5 multilang-detok BLEU delta -3.0 vs baseline. Failing locales: zh, ar. Testset: opus-multiscript-2k.

yuki: immediate action: pin tokenizer to prod release and rerun quant without prune. If that clears, we'll bisect normalize + prune combo.

samira: kicked rerun, uploaded tokenizer.json + qconfig to ticket INF-1602. Blocking customer smoke until resolved.

kevin: FYI the calibration script also strips rare merges; that can break multi-script joins. I'll run a no-prune calibration and share logs.

samira: thanks all — will update ticket with results. :pray:
